tools.name: security_preflight
tools.description: Run a $1 static Security Preflight and return a signed receipt. New x402 payer wallets may receive the fleet-wide $0.01 introductory call. No deployed endpoint is fetched or tested. Importing the receipt into an Agent Market profile is a separate, explicit action.

tools.name: get_security_receipt
tools.description: Read a previously issued public, input-redacted receipt.
